messages:
olivia: quick follow-up from today’s all-hands security Q&A — customers are asking for concise dates for SOC2/ISO evidence, BYOK for EU, and the VPC private control plane.

 tara (Security): short answers: evidence automation is top priority this quarter; BYOK (key import) for EU planned as a beta later in the year; VPC private control plane GA after that. i’ll post a short timeline to the follow-up doc.

 samir: audit logs question: will we support per-org S3 exports and configurable retention?

 dev-platform: yes — planned features: daily S3 snapshot, syslog/webhook streaming, and per-org retention via console/API. beta next month. sample CLI: `redwood audit export --org acme --dest s3://acme-exports --from 2026-04-01 --to 2026-04-30`.

 maria: default redaction? auditors sometimes need raw logs.

 tara (Security): default exports redact PII. unredacted bundles available through an audited workflow (NDA + approval).

 olivia: any ETA numbers we can give to sales?

 tara (Security): targets: evidence pack + UI improvements by end of Q2 (June); KMS BYOK (EU import) beta mid-Q3; cross-account KMS/HSM and rotation APIs Q4; VPC private control plane GA Q4. audit-export beta early next month (May). all tentative.

 compliance-bot: @maria created COMP-601 "SOC2/ISO one-pager + BYOK/VPC FAQ" assigned to @maria, due 2026-05-08.

 maria: will draft the one-pager and post to #docs by EOD Friday.

 olivia: thanks — please add the roadmap bullets to the all-hands follow-up so I can include them in the summary email.
